name: Raza Ahmed
profile: Graduated with honors from the University of Dhaka, Raza Ahmed has built a reputation over a decade in the field of Criminal Law. With a winning record in over 120 cases, his sharp legal instincts and dedication to justice make him a top choice for clients seeking dependable criminal defense. His professionalism, courtroom confidence, and client-first approach set him apart as a leading advocate.

name: Abul Hasan
profile: Abul Hasan completed his law degree from Rajshahi University, specializing in Family Law. In his 8 years of practice, he has successfully resolved over 90 family disputes, including complex custody and divorce cases. Known for his empathetic approach and meticulous legal preparation, he ensures that every client feels supported and informed throughout the legal process.

name: Ali Rahman
profile: Ali Rahman is an alumnus of North South University and a veteran in Corporate Law with over 12 years of experience. He has helped more than 100 startups and corporations navigate legal complexities, mergers, and compliance issues. His strategic insight and business acumen make him the go-to advisor for corporate clients looking for reliable legal counsel.

name: Khairul Islam
profile: Khairul Islam earned his law degree from Chittagong University and has focused his 7-year career on Immigration Law. With over 85 successful visa and asylum cases, he is recognized for his deep knowledge of international regulations and his ability to simplify complex immigration issues. Clients appreciate his transparency and high success rate.

name: Manzurul Karim
profile: An expert in Tax Law, Manzurul Karim is a graduate of Jagannath University. Over 15 years, he has saved millions for clients by identifying strategic tax solutions. He is widely respected for his integrity, precision, and deep understanding of Bangladesh's tax codes. His high-value clients rely on him for risk-free tax planning and representation.

name: Sohel Rana
profile: Sohel Rana, who studied at BRAC University, has spent 9 years mastering Employment Law. Known for winning over 70 labor dispute cases, he defends both employers and employees with equal tenacity. His deep empathy for workers’ rights and comprehensive understanding of labor regulations make him a trusted legal partner.

name: Dipok Choudhury
profile: Dipok Choudhury, a graduate of East West University, specializes in Intellectual Property Law. In 6 years, he has protected more than 100 trademarks, patents, and copyrights. His clients include artists, startups, and tech innovators who value his dedication to safeguarding their ideas and creativity.

name: Nabil Azad
profile: Nabil Azad is a University of Dhaka graduate and a fierce advocate for Civil Rights. With a decade-long career and over 110 successful human rights cases, his clients include NGOs and individuals facing discrimination. He is praised for his moral clarity and ability to challenge unjust systems.

name: Farhana Yasmin
profile: Farhana Yasmin, who earned her law degree from the University of Chittagong, specializes in Environmental Law. In just 5 years, she has led 50+ landmark cases involving environmental protection and corporate accountability. Her passion for sustainability and justice makes her a standout in her field.

name: Imran Kabir
profile: Imran Kabir, a top graduate from the University of Rajshahi, has over 13 years of experience in Bankruptcy Law. With more than 130 cases handled, he provides struggling businesses and individuals a second chance. Clients admire his compassion, discretion, and strategic guidance through financial recovery.

name: Sadia Noor
profile: Sadia Noor, a graduate of BRAC University, has been practicing Medical Malpractice Law for 8 years. She has successfully represented over 60 clients in claims against hospitals and clinics. Her attention to detail and medical knowledge ensure justice for victims of negligence and malpractice.

name: Tariq Mahmud
profile: Tariq Mahmud is a leading Insurance Law expert and alumnus of East West University. With 10 years in the field and more than 100 insurance dispute resolutions, he is known for turning denied claims into victories. His negotiation skills and legal insight bring clients both compensation and peace of mind.

name: Samira Rahim
profile: Samira Rahim, who graduated from the University of Dhaka, shines in Entertainment Law. Her 7-year track record includes over 80 successful contract negotiations and copyright protection cases. Artists and media professionals trust her to protect their rights and navigate the complex entertainment industry.

name: Hasib Rahman
profile: Hasib Rahman, a constitutional scholar from Rajshahi University, has over 14 years of experience and more than 120 court victories. Known for his work in civil liberties and legislative challenges, he’s a top-tier advocate for anyone facing issues involving state laws and fundamental rights.

name: Nusrat Jahan
profile: Nusrat Jahan studied law at the University of Chittagong and has spent 6 years specializing in Education Law. With 60+ cases resolved involving institutional negligence and student rights, she is known for her dedication to academic fairness and justice in educational settings.

name: Zubair Hossain
profile: Zubair Hossain graduated from North South University and is a specialist in Real Estate Law. With 90+ successful property dispute resolutions and contract closings, he’s trusted by individuals and developers alike. His clients value his transparency, efficiency, and deep understanding of property law in Bangladesh.
